SELECT count(*) AS "Instances Up"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge
  FROM cnpg_collector_up
  WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
) latest
WHERE gauge = 1

SELECT pod_name AS "Current Primary"
FROM cnpg_collector_up
WHERE role = 'primary' AND pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH col_err AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge
  FROM cnpg_collector_last_collection_error
  WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), switchover AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge
  FROM cnpg_collector_manual_switchover_required
  WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), fencing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge
  FROM cnpg_collector_fencing_on
  WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM col_err WHERE gauge = 1) +
  (SELECT count(*) FROM switchover WHERE gauge = 1) +
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fencing WHERE gauge = 1) AS "Collector/Failover Alerts"

SELECT gauge AS "Min" FROM cnpg_collector_sync_replicas
WHERE value = 'min' AND role = 'primary'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT gauge AS "Expected" FROM cnpg_collector_sync_replicas
WHERE value = 'expected' AND role = 'primary'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT gauge AS "Max" FROM cnpg_collector_sync_replicas
WHERE value = 'max' AND role = 'primary'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH up AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, role, gauge AS up
  FROM cnpg_collector_up WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), recovery AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS in_recovery
  FROM cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), wal_recv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS wal_receiver_up
  FROM cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), streaming AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS streaming_replicas
  FROM cnpg_pg_replication_streaming_replicas WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), version AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, "full" AS pg_version
  FROM cnpg_collector_postgres_version WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), start_time AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS start_epoch
  FROM cnpg_pg_postmaster_start_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), err AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS last_error
  FROM cnpg_last_error WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  u.pod_name AS "Instance",
  u.role AS "Role",
  CASE WHEN u.up = 1 THEN 'Up' ELSE 'Down' END AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN r.in_recovery = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "In Recovery",
  CASE WHEN w.wal_receiver_up = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "WAL Receiver Up",
  s.streaming_replicas AS "Streaming Replicas",
  v.pg_version AS "PG Version",
  round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) - t.start_epoch) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Uptime (hrs)",
  CASE WHEN e.last_error = 1 THEN 'Error' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Last Error"
FROM up u
LEFT JOIN recovery r ON r.pod_name = u.pod_name
LEFT JOIN wal_recv w ON w.pod_name = u.pod_name
LEFT JOIN streaming s ON s.pod_name = u.pod_name
LEFT JOIN version v ON v.pod_name = u.pod_name
LEFT JOIN start_time t ON t.pod_name = u.pod_name
LEFT JOIN err e ON e.pod_name = u.pod_name
ORDER BY "Instance"

WITH wl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, gauge AS write_lag
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_write_lag_seconds WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
), fl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, gauge AS flush_lag
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_flush_lag_seconds WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
), rl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, gauge AS replay_lag
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_replay_lag_seconds WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
), sd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, gauge AS sent_diff
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_sent_diff_bytes WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
), bs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, counter AS backend_start
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_backend_start WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
), bx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (application_name) application_name, counter AS xmin_age
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_replication_backend_xmin_age WHERE application_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY application_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  wl.application_name AS "Application",
  wl.write_lag AS "Write Lag (s)",
  fl.flush_lag AS "Flush Lag (s)",
  rl.replay_lag AS "Replay Lag (s)",
  sd.sent_diff AS "Sent Diff (bytes)",
  to_timestamp(bs.backend_start) AS "Backend Start",
  bx.xmin_age AS "Xmin Age"
FROM wl
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.application_name = wl.application_name
LEFT JOIN rl ON rl.application_name = wl.application_name
LEFT JOIN sd ON sd.application_name = wl.application_name
LEFT JOIN bs ON bs.application_name = wl.application_name
LEFT JOIN bx ON bx.application_name = wl.application_name
ORDER BY "Application"

WITH wal_count AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS wal_files
  FROM cnpg_collector_pg_wal WHERE value = 'count' AND pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), wal_size AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS wal_size_bytes
  FROM cnpg_collector_pg_wal WHERE value = 'size' AND pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), ready AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS ready_files
  FROM cnpg_collector_pg_wal_archive_status WHERE value = 'ready' AND pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), done AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS done_files
  FROM cnpg_collector_pg_wal_archive_status WHERE value = 'done' AND pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  wc.pod_name AS "Instance",
  wc.wal_files AS "WAL Files",
  ws.wal_size_bytes AS "WAL Size",
  r.ready_files AS "Ready to Archive",
  d.done_files AS "Archived (done)"
FROM wal_count wc
LEFT JOIN wal_size ws ON ws.pod_name = wc.pod_name
LEFT JOIN ready r ON r.pod_name = wc.pod_name
LEFT JOIN done d ON d.pod_name = wc.pod_name
ORDER BY "Instance"

WITH archived AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, role, counter AS archived_total
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_archived_count WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), failed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, counter AS failed_total
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), last_arch AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS last_archived_epoch
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_last_archived_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), last_fail AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS last_failed_epoch
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_last_failed_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), reset AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS reset_epoch
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_stats_reset_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  a.pod_name AS "Instance",
  a.role AS "Role",
  a.archived_total AS "Archived Total",
  f.failed_total AS "Failed Total",
  to_timestamp(NULLIF(la.last_archived_epoch, 0)) AS "Last Archived",
  to_timestamp(NULLIF(lf.last_failed_epoch, 0)) AS "Last Failed",
  round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) - r.reset_epoch) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Stats Reset Age (hrs)"
FROM archived a
LEFT JOIN failed f ON f.pod_name = a.pod_name
LEFT JOIN last_arch la ON la.pod_name = a.pod_name
LEFT JOIN last_fail lf ON lf.pod_name = a.pod_name
LEFT JOIN reset r ON r.pod_name = a.pod_name
ORDER BY "Instance"

ORDER BY time

  pod_name AS "Instance",

  state AS "State",

  gauge AS "Connections"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name, datname, usename, state, application_name)
    pod_name, datname, usename, state, application_name, gauge
  FROM cnpg_backends_total
  WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, datname, usename, state, application_name, time DESC
) latest
WHERE gauge > 0
ORDER BY "Instance", "Database", "State"

  (h.counter::float8 / NULLIF(h.counter + r.counter, 0)) * 100 AS value
FROM cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit h
JOIN cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read r
  ON r.pod_name = h.pod_name AND r.datname = h.datname AND r.time = h.time
WHERE $__timeFilter(h.time) AND h.pod_name IN ($instance)

  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pod_name, datname ORDER BY time)
)
SELECT time, pod_name || ' / ' || datname || ' bytes' AS metric, value FROM deltas ORDER BY time

WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    pod_name, datname,
    (counter - lag(counter) OVER w) / extract(epoch FROM (time - lag(time) OVER w)) AS value
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_database_temp_files
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND pod_name IN ($instance)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pod_name, datname ORDER BY time)
)
SELECT time, pod_name || ' / ' || datname || ' files' AS metric, value FROM deltas ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod_name || ' / ' || datname AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod_name || ' / ' || datname || ' xid' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM cnpg_pg_database_xid_age
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod_name || ' / ' || datname || ' mxid' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM cnpg_pg_database_mxid_age
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY time

WITH lo AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name, datname) pod_name, datname, gauge AS lo_pages
  FROM cnpg_collector_lo_pages WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, datname, time DESC
), nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS nodes_used
  FROM cnpg_collector_nodes_used WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  lo.pod_name AS "Instance",
  lo.datname AS "Database",
  lo.lo_pages AS "Large Object Pages",
  n.nodes_used AS "K8s Nodes Used"
FROM lo
LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.pod_name = lo.pod_name
ORDER BY "Instance", "Database"

WITH ver AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, "full" AS pg_version
  FROM cnpg_collector_postgres_version WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), bg_reset AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS bgwriter_reset
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_bgwriter_stats_reset_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), cp_reset AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS checkpointer_reset
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_checkpointer_stats_reset_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
), arch_reset AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_name) pod_name, gauge AS archiver_reset
  FROM cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_stats_reset_time WHERE pod_name IN ($instance)
  ORDER BY pod_name, time DESC
)
SELECT
  v.pod_name AS "Instance",
  v.pg_version AS "PG Version",
  round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) - b.bgwriter_reset) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Bgwriter Reset Age (hrs)",
  round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) - c.checkpointer_reset) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Checkpointer Reset Age (hrs)",
  round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) - a.archiver_reset) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Archiver Reset Age (hrs)"
FROM ver v
LEFT JOIN bg_reset b ON b.pod_name = v.pod_name
LEFT JOIN cp_reset c ON c.pod_name = v.pod_name
LEFT JOIN arch_reset a ON a.pod_name = v.pod_name
ORDER BY "Instance"
